name: Barman Cass

intro.text: A Painkiller is one part rum, four parts pineapple, a splash of orange, two of coconut cream, a grating of nutmeg. I'm not telling you the rest.

win: On the house. The drink, I mean, not the fight.
after: Nutmeg on top. Always nutmeg. Anything else is just juice with ideas.
